text: Can you describe the appearance of the rash and how long you have had these symptoms? Have you noticed any changes in your nails or skin thickening on your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you notice any linear streaks of rash that seem to follow the path of your hands brushing against vegetation or animals? Have you observed any scaling or thickening of the skin on your palms or soles?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow thinning, and palm numbness alongside your occupational exposure strongly suggests a specific parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin_scraping_for_mites

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative parasite tests, I need to rule out systemic causes like sarcoidosis or leprosy. Do you have any history of diabetes, vitamin B12 deficiency, or exposure to chemicals in your farming work?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of hypopigmented macules, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and peripheral neuropathy, I suspect Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Slit_skin_smear_for_acid_fast_bacilli

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative slit skin smear makes leprosy less likely, so I need to consider other causes for this specific constellation of symptoms. Do you have any family history of similar skin issues, or have you noticed any scaly patches on your scalp or face?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any silvery scales on the rash, and do you have any joint pain or stiffness? REQUEST TEST: Skin_biopsy
